label: Deposit size spread (coefficient of variation)
note: Population standard deviation of dots[].area_ratio divided by its mean, over the 12 deposits that were actually dispensed. vision/main.py reports the same value (0.7352). Driven by the three oversized carries, not by general scatter: the other nine deposits sit between 0.85 and 1.01.

label: Mean deposit circularity
note: Mean of dots[].circularity over the dispensed deposits. Above the 0.80 threshold, so the oversized deposits are round rather than smeared.

label: Missing deposits
note: Profile positions with no deposit: dots 0, 6 and 9 in dispense order.

label: Oversized deposits
note: Dots 1, 7 and 10, measuring 3.41x to 4.01x the recipe's nominal area.

label: Undersized deposits
note: No deposit is small; the starved shots are absent altogether.

label: Small dots with a following dot
note: Dots tagged missing or undersized that are not last in dispense order. Dispense order is the profile index order, which holds for every vision/synth layout; a real recipe must supply it.

label: Small dots followed by an oversized dot
note: All three misses are followed immediately by an oversized deposit (0->1, 6->7, 9->10). This is the signature matc82 sec 3.5 describes.

label: Chance that a given dot is oversized
note: Oversized dots among dispense positions 2..15 (the positions that can follow another dot): 3 of 14.

label: Probability of this many small-then-big pairs by chance
note: Binomial probability of at least small_then_big_count successes in small_dot_count tries at oversized_share. About 1%, so the pairing is unlikely to be coincidence.
